class.name: JRPGRandom
class.brief_description: Deterministic random numbers for JRPG game logic.
class.description: A PCG32 random number generator that only produces integers, so the same seed gives the same results on every platform and on game clients and servers. Its state can be saved with [method get_state] and restored exactly with [method set_state].

method.name: chance_bp
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] with probability [param bp] / 10000 (basis points). 10000 or more is always [code]true[/code]; 0 or less is always [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the generator state as a [Dictionary] with [code]state[/code] and [code]inc[/code].

method.name: next_u32
method.description: Returns the next 32-bit unsigned random number.

method.name: pick_weighted
method.description: Returns an index into [param weights], chosen with probability proportional to its weight. Negative weights count as 0. Returns -1 when every weight is 0.

method.name: range
method.description: Returns a uniform random integer from [param low] to [param high], both included. The range may be at most 2^32 values wide.

method.name: seed
method.description: Seeds the generator. Different [param sequence] values give independent streams for the same [param seed].

method.name: set_state
method.description: Restores a state returned by [method get_state].
